title: Teacher Salary Australia: Convert Your Hourly Rate to Annual, Fortnightly, and After-Tax Pay
description: Learn how to convert a teacher salary Australia hourly rate to annual, fortnightly, and take-home pay using Fair Work award rates, 38-hour weeks, tax, and super.
salarySummary: For a full-time teacher at Level 1 under the Educational Services (Teachers) Award, the minimum weekly rate is $1,455.40 for 38 hours per week, equating to $75,941 per year before tax.

faqs.q: How is a teacher salary Australia calculated from an hourly rate?
faqs.a: Multiply your hourly rate by 38 hours per week (the standard full-time week under the Educational Services (Teachers) Award) and then by 52 weeks. For example, a Level 1 teacher at $38.30 per hour earns $38.30 × 38 × 52 = $75,941 annually. The fortnightly pay is roughly the weekly rate times two, or $2,910.80 before tax.

faqs.q: What tax and Medicare levy apply to a teacher salary Australia?
faqs.a: Using the 2026–27 resident tax scale: no tax on the first $18,200, then 15% up to $45,000, 30% up to $135,000, and so on. A teacher earning $75,941 would pay about $11,500 in tax plus the 2% Medicare levy (about $1,519). Use the [take-home pay](/topics/take-home) tool for a precise estimate.

faqs.q: How does casual loading affect a teacher salary Australia?
faqs.a: Casual teachers under the award get a 25% loading on the daily rate. For a Level 1 teacher, a full day casual rate is $363.85 (weekly rate $1,455.40 ÷ 5 plus 25%). This loading is paid on top of the base hourly rate, not included in it. See [casual loading](/topics/casual-loading) for more.

bodyMarkdown:
## Understanding Teacher Salary Australia: From Hourly to Annual

If you are a teacher in Australia, you likely work under the **Educational Services (Teachers) Award 2020** (MA000077). This award sets minimum pay rates for teachers in preschools, schools, and long day care centres. The standard full-time week is 38 ordinary hours, as defined in clause 10 of the award. To convert an hourly rate to an annual salary, use the formula: **hourly rate × 38 hours per week × 52 weeks per year**.

For example, a Level 1 teacher (graduate or provisional accreditation) has a minimum weekly rate of $1,455.40 per week, which equals $38.30 per hour. Multiply by 38 hours and 52 weeks gives $75,941 per year. The fortnightly pay is $2,910.80 (weekly × 2). This is the base rate before any allowances, penalties, or casual loading.

### Award Rates for Teacher Salary Australia

The Fair Work Ombudsman publishes the official pay guide for this award. The table below shows the five classification levels for teachers in preschools and schools:

| Classification | Weekly Rate | Hourly Rate | Annual Salary |
|---|---|---|---|
| Level 1 | $1,455.40 | $38.30 | $75,941 |
| Level 2 | $1,590.70 | $41.86 | $83,004 |
| Level 3 | $1,731.70 | $45.57 | $90,362 |
| Level 4 | $1,872.70 | $49.28 | $97,720 |
| Level 5 | $2,013.70 | $52.99 | $105,076 |

These rates apply from 1 July 2026. For long day care centres, the rates are 4% higher (e.g., Level 1 annual $78,979). Part-time teachers are paid pro rata based on their ordinary hours. Casual teachers engaged for less than five consecutive days receive no higher than Level 3 rate, with a 25% loading on the daily rate.

### Casual Loading and Casual Teacher Salary Australia

Casual teachers get a 25% loading on the daily rate. For a Level 1 teacher, a full day casual rate is $363.85 (weekly rate divided by 5 plus 25%). This loading is paid on top of the base hourly rate. Do not include the loading in the hourly rate you type into a calculator. Use the [casual loading](/topics/casual-loading) guide to understand how it works.

### Tax and Super for Teacher Salary Australia

Once you have your annual gross salary, you can estimate tax and super. The Australian Taxation Office (ATO) 2026–27 resident tax rates are: nil to $18,200; 15% to $45,000; 30% to $135,000; 37% to $190,000; 45% above. A teacher earning $75,941 would pay about $11,500 in tax plus the 2% Medicare levy (generally 2% of taxable income. The Medicare levy reduction thresholds for singles in 2025–26 are used here.

Superannuation guarantee is 12% of ordinary earnings, paid on top of your salary. For a teacher earning $75,941, the employer contributes $9,113 per year (up to the $270,830 maximum contribution base). This super is not deducted from your pay; it is additional. See [super and packaging](/topics/super-and-packaging) for more.

### Using the Timesheet and Pay Guides

To convert your own hourly rate, use [the timesheet](/). Enter your base hourly rate (without casual loading) and the tool calculates annual, fortnightly, and monthly figures. The [pay guides](/blog) provide summaries of awards including teacher rates. For more detailed reference tables, see [reference tables](/data).

### National Minimum Wage and Teacher Salary Australia

The National Minimum Wage from 1 July 2026 is $26.44 per hour, or $1,004.90 per week for 38 hours. Casual employees get $33.05 per hour including 25% loading. Teacher award rates are higher than the minimum, reflecting qualifications and experience. The Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS) reports average weekly earnings for full-time adult ordinary time at $2,083.70 (May 2026). A teacher at Level 5 earns close to that average.

### Fortnightly Pay for Teachers

Most teachers are paid fortnightly. The award (clause 18.1) allows payment fortnightly, monthly, or every four weeks. For a Level 1 teacher, fortnightly gross is $2,910.80. After tax and Medicare, take-home pay is roughly $2,400 depending on your tax file number and other factors. Use the [take-home pay](/topics/take-home) estimator for a personalised calculation.

### Summary

To calculate a teacher salary Australia, start with your hourly rate from the award, multiply by 38 hours and 52 weeks. Add casual loading if applicable. Then estimate tax and super. The Fair Work Ombudsman and Fair Work Commission are the authoritative sources. Always check the award for your specific classification and workplace.
